result.evidence: Word count is about 140, within the ~135 target. c1: Most claims are supported by the body. "Since 2000, the Large Programme has been activated nine times" omits the body's cutoff, which is the end of December 2000. "Ongoing work also targets... the short-duration GRB subclass" presents a stated aim as ongoing work; the body lists short-burst follow-up only as a planned objective. "Space missions since 1996" is a reasonable paraphrase, though the body credits BeppoSAX first. c2: The problem, method and milestones are covered. However, GRB names are omitted throughout: 970111, 970228, 980425, 990510/990712 and 980329/990705. The abstract also leaves out the 5 non-detections and the unconfirmed red object GRB000830 with its caveat. Findings are generic: "optical polarization discoveries" and "redshift determinations of several GRBs" name no bursts. c3: The abstract is coherent, logically ordered, self-contained and correctly sized.
